name: Psychologic Love Comedy
original_name: サイコロジック・ラブコメディ
source: A girl wakes up in a strange room where everything seems to be chaos. The only number available on her AR is someone named Haruki, and as she knocks out guards who point guns at her, she agrees to meet this mysterious boy who she feels that she can trust.
translation: 一个女孩在一个陌生的房间里醒来，一切似乎都很混乱。她的AR上唯一可用的号码是一个名叫春树的人，当她击倒用枪指着她的警卫时，她同意会见这个她认为可以信任的神秘男孩。
